confront.speaker: Razorbeak Nest
confront.text: Two long-beaked shapes shuffle up from a scrape of trampled grass, wings half-spread, screeching thin and high. Alone, they'd already be running. There are two of them.

options._comment: #330 R1: the corusdeer talk-down's shape. Dormant, never remove -- the cull bounty respawns.
options.text: [Basic Command] Crouch low. Give the nest room.
